newsitem.title: USA: Southwestern Public sees progress on merger.
newsitem.headline: Southwestern Public sees progress on merger.

text.p: Southwestern Public Service Co and Public Service Co of Colorado said on Friday that they and several other energy companies and government agencies filed a nearly unanimous settlement before the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, urging it to approve the merger of the two electric utilities.
The agreement marks progress toward merging the companies as early as January 1997, said Bill Helton, SPS chairman and chief executive.
Helton would become chairman and chief executive of New Century Energies, the holding company to be formed by the merger.
